items.a: Send us the reservation form. We check availability, confirm your booking via WhatsApp and arrange all details directly with you.

Free cancellation up to 24 hours before departure.

about.title: About us
about.lead: We're a small family business from Poreč. For years we've been showing guests from all over the world the most beautiful coastline of Istria.
about.body: Bachitours is personal, honest and local. We know the bays, the best times for spotting dolphins and the small restaurants only locals know. When you book with us, you talk directly with the crew – no anonymous platform, no hidden fees.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Message us on WhatsApp or by email – we reply in 4 languages.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.lead: The following terms apply to all tours booked with Bachitours.

cancellation.title: Cancellation policy
cancellation.lead: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before tour start. In case of bad weather you receive a 100% refund or free rebooking.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: We handle your data confidentially and never share it with third parties.
